page_preservation_method: Decoded page content bytes, all resource stream payloads and nonnumeric resource dictionaries, all five page boxes, rotation and extracted text. Indirect object IDs excluded. Numeric resource dictionaries compared to1e-7 PDF units to account for pypdf floating serialization; actual differences exported per page. No page transform or scaling applied. Legend pages preserved from selected-content renderer.
assembler_write_scope: Static source inspection: all write/renderer output targets are under the selected consolidated output directory; no protected F1/F5/F6 path is a write target. Original outline_v2 and protected assets additionally match pre-revision baseline hashes.

visual_inspection.method: Actual assembled main.pdf pages1–6 rasterized by Poppler at1800px and viewed individually, including all three typeset legends. No source preview substitution.

pages.finding: Actual print plate retained; all seven panels and keys readable.
Correct F2 caption, complete one-page body, subscripts and bounds readable; no clipping.
Actual compact A/B/C plate retained; measured vector math, early-rate slice and WP labels clear.
Correct F3 caption; physical moment/P math visibly typeset, full645 and finite-tail qualifications retained; no clipping.
Actual four-model native/vector-memory plate retained; magnitude coverage and contrast key clear.
Correct F4 caption; conditional direction/whole-seed uncertainty, windows and936+26 scopes readable; no clipping.

visual_inspection.supplement_review_scope: All64 assembled pages match the exact reviewed source page content/resources; source artwork readability inherited from explicitly hashed independent receipts, not re-claimed as a new64-page scientific replay.

resource_rounding_render_check.conclusion: All six affected pages have identical pixels and byte-identical PNG output; decoded scientific drawing/font/image streams are unchanged.
